description: Wah Noble Chemicals Limited is part of the Wah Nobel group, a joint venture founded in 1962 between Wah Industries Limited, Saab of Sweden and Almisehal of Saudi Arabia. The group describes itself as a multinational group of six companies engaged in the production of commercial explosives and accessories, a range of industrial chemicals, and paints.
sourceNote: Wah Nobel group website (wahnobel.com: home, contact), read 2026-10-17. The site presents the group rather than a company-by-company breakdown, so only group-level facts are stated and no product list is given for this entity; the address is not published in a form this record can rely on.
